modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
Every cat owner knows this move: jump on the counter, look you dead in the eye, push the mug off 🐈☕️

We gave the same prompt to 4 AI video models. Only two of them actually knocked the mug off, the other two made it vanish into thin air 👀

Seedance 2.5 · $1.15
Kling 4.0 · $1.32
Wan 3.0 · $0.84
MiniMax H3 · $0.40

Which one is the most realistic cat? 👇

Made with all four on OpenClips. Prompt in the comments.

originalPrompt: Realistic 16:9 home video, 10 seconds, a bright modern kitchen in daylight, static camera at counter height. A fluffy orange tabby cat sits on the wooden floor, staring up at the white kitchen counter, its tail swishing. It wiggles its back legs and jumps, landing smoothly on top of the counter on all four paws. It walks slowly along the counter to a white coffee mug standing near the edge. It looks straight at the camera, then pushes the mug with one paw until it tips over the edge and falls out of frame. A loud crash of the mug breaking on the floor. The cat sits down calmly on the counter, unbothered. Sounds: soft paws on wood, a light thud as it lands, gentle footsteps on the counter, the crash of the mug, a quiet meow.
